# ALVA Developer Preview 3

This is a **test/developer preview**, not a production release. It packages the
current public compiler with refreshed onboarding and agent integration material.

## What's updated

- A clearer English homepage and a complete Simplified Chinese overview.
- Version-specific quickstarts, installation instructions, troubleshooting and
  examples, plus a public index of ongoing development.
- Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS Apple Silicon binaries reporting
  `alva 0.14.1-preview.3`, accompanied by `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- Installers and homepage links now target this exact version.

The compiler/AIR/AEP/MCP implementation is unchanged from Preview 2. This release
does not claim new language features or an Agent correctness improvement. Current
public Codex/Claude packaging and the shared Skill are available from the source
checkout; packages do not contain a separate compiler or model credentials.

## Download and install

Use the archive matching your platform:

- `alva-v0.14.1-preview.3-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `alva-v0.14.1-preview.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
- `alva-v0.14.1-preview.3-macos-aarch64.tar.gz`

Verify the archive against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, then extract it. The automatically
generated source archives are not prebuilt binary packages.

Windows PowerShell (review the remote script before execution):

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zkidp/alva-core/v0.14.1-preview.3/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
alva --version
alva doctor
```

Linux x64 / macOS Apple Silicon:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zkidp/alva-core/v0.14.1-preview.3/scripts/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
alva --version
alva doctor
```

Checking programs and running the Native MCP server do not require building ALVA.
`alva build` and `alva run` additionally need Rust/Cargo. WASM/WASI builds need the
corresponding Rust target.

## What is not bundled

The newer guarded-maintenance Host, Python Guard, bounded-context prototypes and
JSON component branches remain separate development checkouts. The homepage links
to their exact public versions; those links do not make them release features.
No open implementation/research PR is merged as part of this release.

Checks and successful transactions are not proofs of full task behavior. This
preview does not provide malicious-code isolation for ordinary CLI execution.
APIs/storage formats may change. Previous tags and release assets remain intact.
